non_blocking_findings.title: Post-candidate handoff creation in remotePhase 08 branch
non_blocking_findings.description: The implementer created a handoff document in commit 3c8a80c (origin/phase/08-dashboard-experience HEAD) after marking the material candidate in commit 156ae0d. This is standard practice: mark candidate, create handoff, push. The review was conducted on the candidate material SHA 52ee5050a8538c4e44392cadaa6d496f0adc2db4 as registered in the handoff. This is not a blocking finding; it documents the sequence.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Commits 156ae0d..3c8a80c show mark-candidate followed by handoff creation with no code changes between them.

read_model_boundaries.findings: Dashboard correctly implements a synchronous read-model layer over approved Vidalys Flow domains. No new business lifecycle is introduced. Read-model is composed from Orders (primary axis), Payments (requires_attention/expired), Fulfillment (draft/preparing/ready/in_transit), Messaging (failed/uncertain messages sourced from Orders), and Integrations (degraded connections, failed/uncertain deliveries). Dependency direction is strictly inbound; no dashboard state is written back to canonical domains.

organization_isolation.findings: All selectors receive an Organization object resolved from authenticated user's active Membership; Organization never derives from request data. Cross-Organization tests confirm: dashboard_summary, search, and order_workspace correctly filter and return fail-closed (404 for cross-org workspace). No cross-Organization visibility leaks detected.

http_contract_read_only.findings: Dashboard endpoints are decorated with @login_required and @require_GET. All views are GET-only; POST requests return HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed as validated by test_dashboard_views_are_read_only_and_cross_org_workspace_is_404. No command endpoints or mutations are present.

attention_queues.findings: Attention queues are correctly bounded (DASHBOARD_LIMIT = 8) and operational lists, not inbox or workflow models. They link users back to canonical domain views for actions. No inbound WhatsApp sales conversation domain is hidden inside Dashboard; Messaging remains canonical boundary for existing message records. Queues mirror canonical states: payment.requires_attention, fulfillment.draft/preparing/ready/in_transit, message.failed/uncertain, delivery.failed/uncertain.

order_workspace.findings: Order workspace correctly composes Organization-scoped Order with Customer context, PaymentIntent (one-to-one), Fulfillments, and directly-sourced transactional Messages (source_type=ORDER, organization-filtered). Workspace is read-only and provides navigation to canonical domain screens. No parallel lifecycle or independent state is created. Test confirms workspace returns None for cross-Organization Orders.

privacy_and_fields.findings: Templates expose only operationally-necessary fields: order.display_number, customer_name_snapshot (authorized snapshot), status labels (public API enums), total (BRL domain value), KPI counts. No credentials, webhook secrets, raw callback payloads, arbitrary provider metadata, or complete private contact snapshots are exposed. Connection.key and delivery.operation_key are operational, not credentials.

residual_risks.title: Dashboard is a synchronous derived read model
residual_risks.description: Future data volume and operational query patterns may require dedicated projection/cache work. This is intentionally outside Phase 08 scope and is documented as a known risk in the handoff.
residual_risks.mitigation: Phase 09 (Infrastructure and homologation) will address performance and infrastructure patterns. Attention queues are bounded (limit=8) to prevent query explosion.

residual_risks.title: Attention queues must not accumulate independent business rules
residual_risks.description: Attention queues intentionally mirror canonical domain states (payment.requires_attention, fulfillment.draft, etc.). Future changes must not introduce new dashboard-specific classification rules or workflows.
residual_risks.mitigation: Code review and test gates ensure queues are read-only derived views. Domain owners remain responsible for queue classification logic.

residual_risks.title: Inbound WhatsApp sales conversation domain remains out-of-scope
residual_risks.description: Phase 08 does not include inbound WhatsApp sales conversation or omnichannel inbox. Messaging is the canonical boundary for existing message records. A future inbound sales domain must be explicitly scoped and approved.
residual_risks.mitigation: Dashboard does not attempt to aggregate sales conversations. Deferred list clearly excludes inbound WhatsApp conversation domain.

deferred_scope_validation.validation: None of the deferred items are present in the candidate. Dashboard scope is limited to read-composition of existing approved domains.

checkpoint_recommendation.rationale: Independent Review validates that Phase 08 implementation adheres to architecture, governance, and acceptance criteria. All executable scans pass. Tests are comprehensive (449 tests, 86% coverage). Organization isolation, read-only contract, and N+1 regression are verified. No blocking findings. Residual risks are documented and mitigated by design. The candidate is ready for QA and Security review to issue independent GO/NO-GO technical assessment.
checkpoint_recommendation.next_checkpoint: QA and Security will validate: compliance with regulatory requirements (LGPD), security audit of endpoints, credential handling, webhook signature verification (deferred), data privacy patterns, and absence of side effects. Following QA/Security GO, human approval is required before PR, merge, release, or deploy.
